::: {.callout-note}
## Solid Foundation for Transition to IB / A-Level
Welcome, secondary students! The IGCSE Mathematics program plays an essential role in training logical mathematical thinking, mastering fundamental algebraic manipulations, and building academic English vocabulary. K-Education Hub provides detailed exam preparation resources and past papers for the most popular pathways: **CIE 0580**, **CIE 0607 (International)**, and **Pearson Edexcel 4MA1**.
:::

## Choose Your Exam Pathway

Select your specific exam curriculum below to go directly to its dedicated portal, featuring past papers, marking schemes, worked solutions, and key formula sheets:

::: {.program-grid}

::: {.program-card}
### CIE IGCSE Mathematics (0580)
**Core Cambridge IGCSE Math Curriculum**
* Focus: Algebra, Geometry, Mensuration, Coordinate Geometry, Probability & Statistics. Categorized into Core (target grade C) and Extended (target grades A* to B).
* [Explore Resources (0580) →](cie-0580.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### CIE International Mathematics (0607)
**Cambridge IGCSE International Math**
* Tailored for international schools incorporating Graphic Display Calculators (GDC) early. Focuses on technology-integrated problem solving and mathematical investigation.
* [Explore Resources (0607) →](cie-0607.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics A (4MA1)
**Pearson Edexcel IGCSE Math**
* Highly structured syllabus focusing on practical mathematical applications and strong pure algebra skills. Divided into Foundation and Higher tiers.
* [Explore Resources (4MA1) →](edexcel-4ma1.qmd)
:::

:::

## Cambridge Past Papers Bank

Use the interactive search engine below to find and download Question Papers (QP) and Mark Schemes (MS) for the five Cambridge Mathematics programs: **0580**, **0606**, **0607**, **4024**, and **4037**.

```{=html}
<div class="search-engine-box">
  <h3 style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"><i class="bi bi-search"></i> Cambridge Past Papers Finder</h3>

  <div class="d-flex flex-column gap-3">
    <!-- First row: Syllabus and Year -->
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-3 align-items-center">
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 280px; flex: 1 1 auto;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Syllabus:</span>
        <select id="filter-syllabus" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectSyllabusDropdown()">
          <option value="">All Cambridge Syllabuses</option>
          <option value="0580">0580 - CIE IGCSE Mathematics</option>
          <option value="0606">0606 - CIE IGCSE Additional Mathematics</option>
          <option value="0607">0607 - CIE IGCSE International Mathematics</option>
          <option value="4024">4024 - CIE O-Level Mathematics D</option>
          <option value="4037">4037 - CIE O-Level Additional Mathematics</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 160px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Year:</span>
        <select id="filter-year" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectYearDropdown()" style="min-width: 100px;">
          <option value="">All Years</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Second row: Session & Paper -->
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-3 align-items-center" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding-top: 1rem;">
      <!-- Session Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Session:</span>
        <div id="season-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-season-btn active" data-season="" onclick="selectSeason(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-season-btn" data-season="spring" onclick="selectSeason(this)">Spring</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-season-btn" data-season="summer" onclick="selectSeason(this)">Summer</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-season-btn" data-season="winter" onclick="selectSeason(this)">Winter</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>

      <!-- Paper Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 flex-grow-1">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Paper:</span>
        <div id="paper-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-paper-btn active" data-paper="" onclick="selectPaper(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="1" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 1</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="2" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 2</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="3" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 3</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="4" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 4</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="5" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 5</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="6" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 6</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="past-papers-table-container">
  <p><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Loading past papers...</p>
</div>

<script>
let pastPapersDb = [];
let currentSelectedSyllabus = '';
let currentSelectedYear = '';
let currentSelectedSeason = '';
let currentSelectedPaper = '';
let currentPage = 1;
const pageSize = 10;
let filteredExams = [];

async function loadPastPapersDb() {
  if (pastPapersDb.length > 0) return pastPapersDb;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('cie_past_papers_metadata.json');
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
    pastPapersDb = await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load past papers metadata:', error);
  }
  return pastPapersDb;
}

function populateYearDropdown(db) {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  if (!yearSelect) return;

  const years = new Set();
  db.forEach(item => {
    if (item.year) {
      years.add(item.year.toString().trim());
    }
  });

  const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));

  yearSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Years</option>';
  sortedYears.forEach(year => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearSelect.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function renderTableData() {
  const tableBody = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-body');
  const paginationContainer = document.getElementById('pagination-controls');
  if (!tableBody) return;

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredExams.length / pageSize);
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = Math.max(1, totalPages);

  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
  const end = start + pageSize;
  const pageItems = filteredExams.slice(start, end);

  let html = '';
  pageItems.forEach(exam => {
    const seasonLabel = exam.season.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + exam.season.slice(1);
    const paperLabel = 'Paper ' + exam.paper;
    const syllabusLabel = exam.syllabus_code;
    
    // Variant Label
    const variantLabel = exam.variant ? exam.variant : '—';

    let qpHtml = '';
    if (exam.qp) {
      qpHtml = `<a href="${exam.qp}" target="_blank" title="Download Question Paper" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary bi bi-file-earmark-text" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      qpHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">—</span>`;
    }

    let msHtml = '';
    if (exam.ms) {
      msHtml = `<a href="${exam.ms}" target="_blank" title="Download Mark Scheme" class="btn btn-sm btn-success bi bi-key" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      msHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">—</span>`;
    }

    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${exam.year}</strong></td>
        <td><strong>${seasonLabel}</strong></td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">${syllabusLabel}</span></td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.1); color: #4b5563; border: 1px solid rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">${paperLabel}</span></td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #d97706; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">Variant ${variantLabel}</span></td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${qpHtml}</td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${msHtml}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });
  tableBody.innerHTML = html;

  if (totalPages <= 1) {
    paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  let pagHtml = '';
  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage - 1})">Prev</button>`;
  
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (i === currentPage) {
      pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary active">${i}</button>`;
    } else {
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - currentPage) <= 1) {
        pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
      } else if (i === 2 || i === totalPages - 1) {
        pagHtml += `<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>`;
      }
    }
  }

  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage + 1})">Next</button>`;
  
  paginationContainer.innerHTML = pagHtml.replace(/(<span class="text-muted px-1">\.\.\.<\/span>\s*){2,}/g, '<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>');
}

function changePage(page) {
  currentPage = page;
  renderTableData();
  document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
}

function applyFilters() {
  let filtered = pastPapersDb;

  if (currentSelectedSyllabus) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.syllabus_code === currentSelectedSyllabus);
  }
  if (currentSelectedYear) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.year.toString() === currentSelectedYear);
  }
  if (currentSelectedSeason) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.season === currentSelectedSeason);
  }
  if (currentSelectedPaper) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.paper === currentSelectedPaper);
  }

  const exams = {};
  filtered.forEach(item => {
    const key = `${item.year}_${item.season}_${item.syllabus_code}_${item.paper}_${item.variant}`;
    if (!exams[key]) {
      exams[key] = {
        year: item.year,
        season: item.season,
        syllabus_code: item.syllabus_code,
        paper: item.paper,
        variant: item.variant,
        qp: null,
        ms: null
      };
    }
    if (item.type === 'qp') {
      exams[key].qp = item.link;
    } else if (item.type === 'ms') {
      exams[key].ms = item.link;
    }
  });

  filteredExams = Object.values(exams);
  filteredExams.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.year !== b.year) return parseInt(b.year) - parseInt(a.year);
    if (a.season !== b.season) return a.season.localeCompare(b.season);
    if (a.syllabus_code !== b.syllabus_code) return a.syllabus_code.localeCompare(b.syllabus_code);
    if (a.paper !== b.paper) return a.paper.localeCompare(b.paper);
    return a.variant.localeCompare(b.variant);
  });

  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  if (filteredExams.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #9ca3af;"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> No matching past papers found.</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="table-wrapper">
      <table class="premium-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Year</th>
            <th>Session</th>
            <th>Syllabus</th>
            <th>Paper</th>
            <th>Variant</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">QP</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">MS</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="past-papers-table-body">
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center gap-2 mt-3" id="pagination-controls"></div>
  `;

  currentPage = 1;
  renderTableData();
}

function selectSyllabusDropdown() {
  const syllabusSelect = document.getElementById('filter-syllabus');
  currentSelectedSyllabus = syllabusSelect.value || '';
  applyFilters();
}

function selectYearDropdown() {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  currentSelectedYear = yearSelect.value || '';
  applyFilters();
}

function selectSeason(button) {
  currentSelectedSeason = button.getAttribute('data-season') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-season-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

function selectPaper(button) {
  currentSelectedPaper = button.getAttribute('data-paper') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-paper-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

async function initPastPapersTable() {
  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  const db = await loadPastPapersDb();
  
  if (!db || db.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color: #ef4444;"></i> Error: Failed to load past papers database. Please try again later.</p>';
    return;
  }

  populateYearDropdown(db);
  applyFilters();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initPastPapersTable();
});
</script>
```

---

## Teacher's Advice for Exam Prep

1. **Master Algebraic Manipulation**: Algebra is the language of mathematics. Solving quadratic equations, simultaneous equations, and simplifying algebraic fractions must be practiced thoroughly to avoid losing points due to silly mistakes.
2. **Geometry and Mensuration Skills**: Always bring a ruler, compass, and protractor to the exam hall. Neat drawings help identify circle properties, similar triangles, or trigonometric relationships easily.
3. **Read Questions Carefully**: Pay close attention to rounding requirements (e.g., round to 3 significant figures, or round angles to 1 decimal place).
